verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. Sequential verification of all thirteen proof blocks found that the ordinary-open product tube, weighted toric cofinality, completed-residue-field singleton-Shilov arguments, all-orbit monoid localization, rigid-etale R-PL descent, and quasi-smooth dependency are valid. The v3 argument correctly separates rank zero, establishes coefficient contraction, uses one common Newton radius for all four root problems, proves the crossed composites by exact-root uniqueness, constructs actual strict analytic neighbourhoods from the standard-etale chart, obtains the product with a quasi-smooth fixed-fibre factor, and derives local R-PL regularity and Gubler--Jell--Rabinoff harmonicity. Every external citation was queried through search_arxiv_theorems first and then, when needed, checked against the primary web/PDF source; the statements, definitions, and hypotheses match every application. The two imported dependency artifacts and production responses also match their supplied SHA-256 hashes and zero-finding verdicts. No critical error or proof gap was found.
